title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཙེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 186)
shelf_note: Authentic canonical Tibetan Buddhist Pramāṇa (epistemology/logic) commentary from the Derge Tengyur collection.

ocr_errors.problem: Initial auspicious syllable and interrogative particle missing at beginning of line 1
Conditional particle ན་ misread as conjunction དང་
Adverbial particle བར་ misread as genitive བའི་

tr_errors_A.problem: Translates ma 'dres par (in an unmixed/isolated manner) as 'without confusion', conflating it with ma 'chol bar

tr_errors_A.english: Anticipating a doubt regarding the existence of something purposeless
tr_errors_A.problem: Awkward phrasing for anticipating the objection of superfluity/purposelessness

tr_errors_B.problem: Translates ma 'dres par (in an unmixed/isolated manner) as 'without confusion', conflating it with ma 'chol bar

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B accurately captures the scholastic Pramāṇa commentary structure (distinguishing lemmas, objections, and responses) and provides superior philosophical precision with helpful Sanskrit and Tibetan terminology glosses.

book_verdict: Authentic Derge Tengyur block print folio containing commentary on Buddhist epistemology (Pramāṇa) concerning the cognition of absence, with accurate transcription and faithful English translations.
